install_pilot_wire.title: Qubino Wire Pilot is replaced by Pilot Wire
install_pilot_wire.description:
Qubino Wire Pilot is no longer maintained. Its features are now part of Pilot Wire, which also adds a power sensor to show when the heater is actually heating.

Install Pilot Wire from the Marketplace and restart Home Assistant. Your thermostats will be moved to Pilot Wire automatically, keeping their entity ID.

migrated_to_pilot_wire.title: Qubino Wire Pilot thermostats moved to Pilot Wire
migrated_to_pilot_wire.description:
Your thermostats have been moved to Pilot Wire, keeping their entity ID.

If you configured them in YAML, remove the `qubino_wire_pilot` platforms from your `configuration.yaml` file. Then uninstall Qubino Wire Pilot from the Marketplace and restart Home Assistant.
